tailored:
Hi Koppla team,

What draws me to this role is that you're building a real product end to end: frontend, backend services, and APIs, with engineers who care about the whole feature. That matches how I like to work — I've built fullstack systems where I owned everything from API design to deployment, and I want to keep growing in exactly that direction.

Two examples that fit what you're doing: I designed and built TalentHiv, a fullstack candidate-screening system with Next.js/React/TypeScript on the frontend and FastAPI/PostgreSQL on the backend — REST API, database modelling, validation, type checking, and deployment to Azure and Vercel. I also built a multilingual AI voice assistant for hotels (VoiceHive Hotels) with real-time speech handling and a cost-conscious scalable architecture, and I'm currently building a mobile social platform in Flutter with a security-focused feature set.

Before switching to software development, I spent 20 years leading operational teams of 50+ at Casino Cosmopol in a strictly regulated environment — I'm used to ownership, incident handling, and working cross-functionally with stakeholders.

I'm based in Malmö, Sweden (EU citizen), and I write TypeScript daily.

Best regards,
Anthony Foran
